literal: The nature is for ascetic practice even one thing's absence; possession delusion becomes and further turning back.
translation: The true nature of ascetic renunciation is to possess absolutely nothing; to possess even a single thing will lead one back into delusion.
modern: ஒரு பொருளும் இல்லாமல் இருப்பதே தவத்தின் இயல்பான நிலையாகும்; ஏதேனும் ஒன்றை வைத்திருப்பது மீண்டும் மயக்கத்தை உண்டாக்கிப் பிறவிச் சுழற்சிக்குத் திருப்பிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the absolute nature of renunciation. The natural state of true asceticism is the complete absence of any possession, even a single object. If an ascetic retains or desires even one possession, it acts as a seed of attachment, leading them back into the delusion of worldly life and rebirth. Thus, complete detachment is essential for spiritual liberation.
